prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. ONE square premium painterly encyclopedia illustration of YSBADDADEN PENCAWR, giant antagonist of Welsh Culhwch and Olwen. One gigantic stern aged male giant in woollen medieval robe seated alone on stone bench inside dark Welsh castle hall. Crucial source-backed supernatural anatomy: the paired HEAVY EYEBROW ridges have grown into immense overhanging fleshy folds drooping below both eyes and nearly to upper cheeks, impossibly heavier and longer than normal human brows; two narrow eye openings visible under these huge drooping brow folds. Two long FORKED supports beneath the eyebrows lift them, supported on stone bench sides, no attendants in image. Do not confuse eyebrows with normal moustache or beard. One head, exactly two normal arms/hands resting on bench arms, two legs and feet visible. Huge giant scale conveyed with small medieval doors in background. Whole seated figure head to feet and fork tips uncropped; clearly show both large brow folds and forked supports. Commanding dangerous obstinate giant king aura, not sympathetic ordinary old man or generic horned demon. Long greying beard, opaque modest walnut wool robes, dim cool stone and refined restrained golden shafts of light. No horns, wings, extra eyes, extra limbs, text, border, crown, gore or victims. Eyebrow feature specifically based on Lady Charlotte Guest's translation: forks raise the two eyebrows which have fallen over the giant's eyes.
